source.instrument: Saanich Zoning Bylaw 8200, unofficial consolidated PDF
source.printed_revision: includes marginal amendment references through B. 10299 2026
source.extraction_method: manual selection from official PDF text, pdftotext -layout
source.reuse_status: Official bylaw linked for public reading; permission to redistribute full PDF not established. Only short attributed excerpts retained.

pathway_conditions: Section 5.35(b)(i): parcel zone expressly permits Garden Suite; zone schedule must be verified for the specific lot
Section 5.35(b)(ii): lot lies in Sewer Service Area OR Urban Containment Boundary; both boundary observations and their releases unresolved
Section 5.35(b)(iii-v): lot area at least 400 m2, bylaw Lot Width at least 12 m, principal building is a single family dwelling
Section 5.35(c),(g): at most one garden suite; same fee simple parcel or same strata plan as single family dwelling
Schedule H and applicable zone/sections 5 and 7, servicing, covenants, permits and overlays require separate review

checks.excerpt: The lot must have a minimum area of 400 m2
checks.context: One of five cumulative garden-suite eligibility conditions in §5.35(b).
checks.interpretation: Candidate minimum lot area; no permission follows from this scalar alone.
checks.subject: lot
checks.measurement_definition: area of the lot under Saanich Zoning Bylaw definitions; parcel/strata geometry requires review

checks.excerpt: The lot must be a minimum of 12 m wide
checks.context: The bylaw definition of Lot Width uses a perpendicular line to the line joining front/rear midpoints; a GIS envelope width is not equivalent.
checks.interpretation: Candidate minimum defined lot width; measurement algorithm not implemented.
checks.subject: lot
checks.measurement_definition: Lot Width as defined in Zoning Bylaw 8200 §2, not bounding-box width

checks.excerpt: A garden suite shall have a maximum Gross Floor Area (R) of 93 m2
checks.context: Gross Floor Area (R) is defined in §2 with inclusions and exclusions; manufacturer floor area is not this value.
checks.interpretation: Candidate garden-suite Gross Floor Area (R) ceiling.
checks.subject: garden suite
checks.measurement_definition: Gross Floor Area (R) per Zoning Bylaw 8200 §2, measured to exterior wall faces with stated exclusions

checks.excerpt: A minimum Open Site Space Requirement (GS) of 45% of the area of the lot.
checks.context: §2 excludes buildings, structures, driveways and impervious surfaces from the landscaped numerator, with an above-ground projection exception.
checks.interpretation: Candidate minimum landscaped open-site fraction on a lot with a garden suite; site-surface inputs absent.
checks.subject: lot with garden suite
checks.measurement_definition: Open Site Space Requirement (GS) landscaped area divided by total lot area under §2

quantity.original_text: 45% of the area of the lot

basis.numerator: Open Site Space Requirement (GS) landscaped area

checks.excerpt: A garden suite shall not exceed a height of: 6.5 m
checks.context: The same clause sets 5.5 m for flat roofs or pitch less than 3:12; §3(a-b) also changes setbacks at 4.2 m height.
checks.interpretation: Height ceiling branches by roof form and is coupled to setback branches; retain as unresolved conditional rule.
checks.blocker: ScalarBound alone cannot encode roof-form alternatives and linked setback pathways without reviewed facts and coherent alternative IDs.
